summary: BLOQUE 1 (Tinder-style swipe on Discover) frontend testing - all critical swipe UX behaviors verified working. Tested with demo2@plansobrio.cl at viewport 420x900.

test_results_detail.stamps_exist: PASS - stamp-like ('ME TINCA ✨') and stamp-pass ('PASO 👋') exist with initial opacity=0
test_results_detail.swipe_right_opens_modal: PASS - dragging card >150px right opens '¿Qué plan harías con...' modal
test_results_detail.cancel_flow_returns_card: PASS - clicking X on plan modal closes it, card returns to center with SAME alias (Beno_Deporte, 42) and SAME quota (19/20). No like recorded.
test_results_detail.swipe_right_pick_plan: PASS - swipe right + click 'like-no-plan' advances card (Beno_Deporte→Nelson 42) and decrements quota (19→18)
test_results_detail.swipe_left: PASS - drag left >150px passes card without opening modal (Nelson→Vale_Yoga)
test_results_detail.keyboard_arrow_left: PASS - ArrowLeft advances to next card
test_results_detail.next_card_peek: PASS - StaticProfilePreview visible behind top card with transform: scale(0.95); opacity: 0.55
test_results_detail.photo_dots: NOT TESTED (data limitation) - all demo profiles reachable had 0 photos (dot count=0). Code path exists (profile.photos?.length > 1) with e.stopPropagation, but no demo user with 2+ photos was available in the deck to exercise it.
test_results_detail.scroll: PARTIAL - page is scrollable vertically (scrollY reached 216 after wheel), body scroll is not blocked by drag (touchAction: 'pan-y' set correctly). Full scroll delta wasn't observed because content below card was already near end of scrollable area.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Consider seeding at least one demo user with 2+ photos so the photo-dots interaction can be regression-tested. Currently none of the reachable demo profiles have multiple photos.
critical_code_review_comments: Discover.jsx is 456 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold. If more features are added, consider splitting ProfileCard and StaticProfilePreview into their own files under /components/discover/.
resetRef pattern (imperative reset from parent) is clean and works. Good use of useTransform for stamp opacity mapping.
handleDragEnd uses setTimeout(260) hardcoded to match the fly-out animation duration (0.28s). Consider extracting into a constant to keep them in sync if animation is ever tuned.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable items (10/10 verifiable, 1 not testable due to data)

context_for_next_testing_agent: BLOQUE 1 swipe UX fully verified. All swipe-card/stamp/modal/keyboard/button flows pass. Only photo-dots interaction couldn't be exercised because no demo user in the deck has >=2 photos - this is a seed data gap, not a code bug. Next iteration can proceed to BLOQUE 2.
